# Twenty provider

Manage custom objects, fields, roles, and email-based workspace memberships through Twenty's Metadata API. Data sources look up existing objects, fields, roles, and the authenticated workspace. Workspace settings, global accounts/passwords, object/field permission rules, and individual CRM records are not managed.

Requires **Twenty v2.46.0 or later**. This is the supported and CI-tested minimum, not a runtime version check. The provider is not yet published to the Registry; follow [local setup and authentication](guides/authentication.md).

## Example usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    twenty = {
      source = "glitchedmob/twenty"
    }
  }
}

# Unreleased. Build locally and use a Terraform CLI dev_overrides entry.
# Inject TWENTY_EMAIL and TWENTY_PASSWORD outside checked-in configuration.
provider "twenty" {
  endpoint = "https://twenty.example.com"
}
```

Supply `TWENTY_EMAIL` and `TWENTY_PASSWORD` through your secret-injection process. Omitted or null credentials and endpoint values use their environment fallbacks; explicit values take precedence, including empty strings, which fail validation.

See [custom objects](resources/object.md), [custom fields](resources/field.md), [roles](resources/role.md), and [memberships](resources/workspace_member.md). Object and field deletion is protected by default because it removes stored CRM data. Keep the automation account and an independent recovery administrator outside managed resources; see [membership recovery](guides/membership.md).

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_insecure_http` (Boolean) Allow HTTP for local testing on localhost or a literal loopback IP. Defaults to false. No environment fallback; HTTPS certificate verification remains enabled.
- `email` (String) Verified automation account email. Use one bare ASCII mailbox address, without a display name or comments. Surrounding spaces are trimmed. Environment fallback: `TWENTY_EMAIL`.
- `endpoint` (String) Instance HTTPS base URL without `/metadata`, other paths, credentials, query, or fragment. Environment fallback: `TWENTY_ENDPOINT`. No default.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Automation account password; whitespace is preserved. Environment fallback: `TWENTY_PASSWORD`. Inject through the environment or an ephemeral variable to avoid saving it in plans.
